messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Then there was the time I woke up 3 hours before I went to bed.

output.original_text: Then there was the time I woke up 3 hours before I went to bed.
output.joy: Then there was the time I joyfully realized I woke up 3 hours before I went to bed!
output.sadness: Then there was the time I woke up 3 hours before I went to bed, and it felt so empty.
output.fear: Then there was the terrifying moment I woke up 3 hours before I went to bed; something wasn't right.
output.anger: Then there was the time I woke up 3 hours before I went to bed, and I was so furious about it.
output.surprise: Then there was the unbelievable time I woke up 3 hours before I went to bed!
output.disgust: Then there was the distasteful time I woke up 3 hours before I went to bed, and I just couldn't believe it.
